currentBoundary: The current APK and Unity probes preserve direct TokenShop buy-hook families for token spend and diamond spend through BuyTokenBoost, BuyMK1-8TokenBoost, BuyDiamondBoost, and their hold handlers.
The same local probes preserve BuyLM244 and BuyCollectorDevice as modifier-side hooks around the Daily Tokenium lane, alongside CostBox-Tokenium and Mission Materials Booster player-facing shells.

The checked probe currently returns zero BuyTokenDailiesT2 and BuyTokenDailiesT3 matches in both global-metadata.dat and level0, so TokenDailies should remain mapped as Daily Tokenium modifier families rather than recovered direct TokenShop purchase actions.
This is enough to keep spend action families separated in repo-local grounding, but not enough to recover player-owned levels or planner-ready saved-state inputs.
